sections.name: About Research Development Centre
sections.videoTitle: Welcome to BIU Research & Development Cell
paragraphs: Bareilly International University (BIU) is committed to the pursuit of excellence in research and aims to achieve national and international recognition through interdepartmental and inter institutional collaborative research programmes across the spectrum of Medical & Health Science, Laboratory and Technology, Management, Nursing, Pharmacy as well as Dental Sciences. Research and developmental activities create and disseminate new knowledge in various domains, promotes innovation which will motivate better learning and teaching among faculties, students and research scholars of the University.

To lend a helping hand to the scholar burning the midnight oil, the University subscribes the following database providing access to thousands of journals in different disciplines for full text research articles and sector specific reports.

databases.name: DELNET
databases.subtitle: Developing Library Network
databases.desc: Network of over 7,500 institutions providing union catalog of books, periodicals, and inter-library loan facility.

databases.name: DOAJ
databases.subtitle: Directory of Open Access Journals
databases.desc: Community-curated online directory that indexes and provides access to high quality, open access, peer-reviewed journals.

sections.name: Research Promotion Policy
sections.description: Comprehensive institutional policy governing research incentives, seed grant allowances, intellectual property rights, and commercialization at BIU.

policies.title: Research Promotion Policy
policies.desc: Guidelines on seed money grants, publication incentives, conference travel support, and academic research awards.

policies.title: Research and Professional Development Policy
policies.desc: Faculty and scholar career advancement framework through high-impact clinical and interdisciplinary studies.

policies.title: IPR and Consultancy Policy

policies.title: Innovation & Entrepreneurship Policy

sections.name: Code of Ethics

sections.name: DSIR/SIRO Recognition
sections.description: Official Recognition Certificate granted by Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, recognizing Bareilly International University as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO).
